Both rule test suites pass. The fix changed two files:

- `crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_use_pathlib/rules/replaceable_by_pathlib.rs:100` — PTH123 now matches `["" | "builtins", "open"]` instead of `"builtin"`.
- `crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_bandit/rules/exec_used.rs:109` — S102 now checks `module_name == "builtins"` instead of `"builtin"`.

The existing test fixtures and snapshots (e.g. `S102.py`, `flake8_use_pathlib/import_from.py`, which reference issue #15442) already encode the corrected behavior, and the corresponding test suites pass: `flake8_bandit::tests` (59 passed) and `flake8_use_pathlib::tests` (17 passed).
